text_en: To the leader: according to The Gittith. Of Asaph.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的诗歌，交与乐官。调寄"加特"。

text_en: Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob.
text_cn: 请众向助佑我们的天主歌舞， 向雅各伯的天主欢呼。

text_en: Raise a song, sound the tambourine, the sweet lyre with the harp.
text_cn: 请众高唱诗歌，手击铙鼓， 和弹琴瑟，奏悦耳的乐谱。

text_en: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the full moon, on our festal day.
text_cn: 在月朔之日和月圆之夜， 在我们的庆节，吹起号角，

text_en: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
text_cn: 因为这是以色列的规定， 是雅各伯天主的诫命，

text_en: He made it a decree in Joseph, when he went out over the land of Egypt. I hear a voice I had not known:
text_cn: 当他出击埃及国时， 给若瑟立了这法规。 我听到从未听的诺言：

text_en: “I relieved your shoulder of the burden; your hands were freed from the basket.
text_cn: “我救他的肩脱离重担， 又使他的手放下筐篮。

text_en: In distress you called, and I rescued you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
text_cn: 你在患难中呼号，我救拔了你， 从雷鸣的云彩中，我答应了你； 在默黎巴的水边，我试探了你。 (休止)

text_en: Hear, O my people, while I admonish you; O Israel, if you would but listen to me!
text_cn: 请听，我的百姓，我要警告你！ 以色列！恨不得你能听从我：

text_en: There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
text_cn: 在你中间不应有别的神， 千万不可崇拜外邦的神！

text_en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide and I will fill it.
text_cn: 我是上主，我是你的天主， 是我由埃及国将你领出， 你张开口，我要使它满足。

text_en: “But my people did not listen to my voice; Israel would not submit to me.
text_cn: 可惜我的百姓没有听我的呼声， 以色列人也没有服从我的命令。

text_en: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts, to follow their own counsels.
text_cn: 因此，我就任凭他们的心灵顽硬， 让他们随自己的私意而行。

text_en: O that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
text_cn: 如果我的百姓听了我的命令， 以色列人随从我的道路而行，

text_en: Then I would quickly subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their foes.
text_cn: 我立刻就会压迫他们的敌人， 转过手打击难为他们的仇人。

text_en: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their doom would last forever.
text_cn: 仇恨上主的人必来向他们归顺， 仇人的厄运从此要永久常存。

text_en: I would feed you with the finest of the wheat, and with honey from the rock I would satisfy you. ”
text_cn: 但我要以麦子的精华养育选民， 以石中的蜂蜜饱享他们。”
